body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Lecture: Designing an Exchange Program
paras: Good afternoon. A strong proposal answers four questions. **What is the aim?** To build mutual understanding. **What will be done?** Students will spend a term abroad. **When and how much?** One year, with a budget of €40,000. **Why now?** **Were** such programs **absent**, graduates **would lack** intercultural skills.
**What I recommend is** a pilot with 20 students. **It is recommended that** an evaluation **be carried out** after each term.

items.q: The proposed program lasts a year.
An evaluation is recommended after each term.

blocks.body: Uma proposta persuasiva termina com **pedido claro** (We therefore request…) e **avaliação** (It is recommended that an evaluation be carried out).

items.s: The ___ is to build mutual understanding. (aim)

prompts.model: The aim is to improve exchange.
It is recommended that it be evaluated.

blocks.task: Write a complete proposal (8 sentences) for an exchange program with aim, activities, timeline, budget, rationale and evaluation.
blocks.model: Introduction: This proposal outlines a one-year exchange program between two universities. Aim: The aim is to build mutual understanding. Activities: Twenty students will spend a term abroad. Timeline: The program runs from September to June. Budget: The total cost is €40,000. Rationale: Were such programs absent, graduates would lack intercultural skills. Evaluation: It is recommended that an evaluation be carried out after each term. We therefore request your support.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
